paper_title: NuSTAR bounds on radiatively decaying particles from M82
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 2
notes: Paper derives new astrophysical bounds on axion-photon coupling from NuSTAR observations of the starburst galaxy M82 (26 observations, ~1.96 Ms), constraining ma = 30-500 keV at g_agamma ~ 1e-12 to 1e-10 GeV^-1 (Fig. 2). No numerical table is provided; data points are approximate, reconstructed from text statements: the stated 30-500 keV range with couplings 1e-10 to 1e-12 GeV^-1, and the explicit benchmark at ma = 316 keV where g12 = 0.75 (i.e. g_agamma = 7.5e-13 GeV^-1) 'corresponds to the constraint we obtain'. Intermediate points are interpolated/estimated and should be verified against the published Fig. 2 exclusion curve. Limit uses TS = 2.7 threshold (half-chi-squared, one d.o.f.), corresponding to 95% CL one-sided upper limit.
